newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers no peak, firm power for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers no peak, firm power for Tuesday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered no peak firm power for Tuesday pre-schedulings, compared with 200 megawatts (MW) for its previous offer, the agency said Monday.
BPA continued to offer an unlimited volume of light-load firm power for Tuesday at $9.00 for both the Northwest and California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
BPA prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT were also unchanged at $7.00 for Northwest and $8.00 at COB.
Tuesday non-firm power during hours ending 0600, 0700 and 2300 PDT was unchanged at $10.00.
